pages.title: Tiger's Eye Knife
pages.text: Banded gold from the Crystal Dimension, ground to an edge. Ingot over stick, same as every knife since the first one.

pages.title: Why Carry One
pages.text: A knife is the butcher's whole trade: it works the $(item)Cutting Board$(), and beasts felled with one in hand give up cuts they would otherwise keep — bonus fillets, tentacles, the good parts.$(p)The Tiger's Eye edge outlasts iron, takes enchantments eagerly, and repairs with $(item)Tiger's Eye Ingots$() — glittering considerably harder than a kitchen tool needs to.
